title: Board Policy on Capital Credits (Patronage Capital): Expected Rotation of Pass-Through Allocations Retired Early
content:
# Expected Rotation of Pass-Through Allocations Retired Early

**Policy — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), wholesale-supplier pass-through rows elected by a former member under an approved discounted early retirement.**

The rotation a pass-through row is expected on follows what the wholesale supplier has itself retired on the account:

1. a pass-through year no later than the latest pass-through year the general retirements on the account have reached is already received and is expected in **zero** years — the year it would be retired in the general rotation is its own allocation year;
2. a pass-through year at least **15** years later than that latest year, or on an account where no pass-through general retirement has ever been booked, is expected on the supplier's own rotation of **27** years — the year it would be retired in the general rotation is its allocation year plus 27;
3. for any other pass-through year this rule sets no expected rotation.

## What the records show

The **latest pass-through year reached** is the allocation year of the most recently booked general retirement entry on the account's wholesale-supplier pass-through allocations. An account with no general retirement entry on any pass-through allocation has never had a pass-through general retirement booked.

## Expected rotation table (hypothetical latest year reached: 1999)

| Pass-through allocation year | Years later than 1999 | Expected in |
|---|---|---|
| 1997 | none (earlier) | 0 years |
| 1999 | 0 | 0 years |
| 2000 | 1 | not set by this rule |
| 2013 | 14 | not set by this rule |
| 2014 | 15 | 27 years |
| 2021 | 22 | 27 years |

On an account where no pass-through general retirement has ever been booked, every pass-through year is expected on 27 years.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** On an account whose latest pass-through year reached is 1999, a 2014 pass-through row elected in 2026 is expected in 2014 plus 27, that is 2041: 15 whole years from the year of the election.
